notes: PLEA test run 3 on Sepolia (chain 11155111): the accepted launch #1311 code plus letters and auto-sell (Letterbox), a 1% minimum plea, the owner excluded from seasons and keeper tips, a six-season PLEA bonus and the Cabal's judging rules v2; Laureates (season NFTs) removed, display names kept in the Letterbox. The factory deploys PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one transaction (test/LaunchManifest.t.sol checks calldata and deployment gas plus a 1,100,000-gas allowance for the measured ProjectFactory overhead, with 22% gas-limit headroom, against Ethereum's 16,777,216 per-transaction cap). Atomic deployment is required: PLEA.setLauncher accepts either the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block, and PleaLaunch's constructor registers the system contracts. Constructor arguments, in declaration order: PLEA(owner = $owner). CabalGate(PLEA, Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, oracle fee asset 0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a, TestIMD 0x2B69099E59b05901faA1DD164fabf098bf831E82, oracle signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, season 18000 s, dead-man 118800 s). Seasons(PLEA, CabalGate, TestIMD). PleaDistributor(PLEA, owner = $owner). PleaLaunch(PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, Sepolia Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543, TestIMD, imd/acc launch #1294 Stacker 0x0457276d7b036818b3eddc1a4a3fceda61e9314d, credit gas 1300000, START 1792162800, the Letterbox's oracle fee asset 0x44a1cd38474fb1748400e7deb5f8d786cce3f89a, mintOracleFee = true (on Sepolia the oracle fee token is a separate open-mint test token, so the Letterbox mints the 0.5 fee; refused on chain id 1), and the keccak256 of the Letterbox's creation code, which takes no constructor arguments). PLEA and PleaDistributor receive $owner; PleaLaunch reads that owner from PLEA. Seasons reads CabalGate's timing, and PleaLaunch registers the system with PLEA; constructors do not call the configured external services. After the launch, anyone calls PleaLaunch.deployLetterbox(creationCode) once: it checks the code against the committed hash, deploys the Letterbox with CREATE2 (it reads its settings from PleaLaunch) and registers it with PLEA (PLEA.setLetterbox, launcher only, once); its own transaction, also checked against the gas cap. PleaHook is not a manifest entry either: PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode) deploys it with CREATE2 using a salt mined off chain, then PLEA.init mints 87% to the hook, 3% to Seasons and 10% to PleaDistributor; each of the first six seasons pays 5,000,000 PLEA to its qualifying top 10 and burns the unpaid rest; flushToWall burns what is left; nobody can withdraw it. seed() opens trading (owner any time, anyone from START). PLEA supply is zero after the launch transaction. The accepted appeal retry, balance-growth and current-owner keeper-tip audit fixes are retained. PLEA's owner may grant permanent sender exemptions; PleaDistributor's owner sets its claim root once. PleaLaunch and PleaHook retain the owner read from PLEA at launch; the oracle signer is the configured trusted attester.
